# Los Angeles City Clerk

> > Official repository for Los Angeles municipal records, council files, ordinances, contracts, and Neighborhood Council administration.

The Office of the City Clerk maintains the city's legislative record through the Council File Management System (LACityClerk Connect) and administers Neighborhood Council funding and operations. This site provides access to historical official records, board appointments, and municipal governance documents.

## Key Topics

- Council File Management System
- LACityClerk Connect
- Neighborhood Council funding
- City ordinances and contracts
- Municipal records and agenda packets
- Board of Police Commissioners
- Board of Public Works
- Budget and Finance Committee
- Ad Hoc Committee on Homelessness
- Ad Hoc Committee on Police Reform
- Ad Hoc Committee on 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games
- Council file search
- Payment requests and budget management
- City officials and appointments

## Core Systems

- [LACityClerk Connect](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/lacityclerkconnect/): Council File Management System for LA ordinances, contracts & records
- [Neighborhood Council Funding System](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/NCFundPortal/): Neighborhood Council funding portal for budget & payment management

## Officials and Appointments

- [Board of Police Commissioners Records](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/ChronoLA/index.cfm?fuseaction=app.Faculties&organizationid=223&OfficeID=978&ElectionID=64): Board of Police Commissioners historical records from 1931 election
- [Board of Public Works Commissioners](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/chronola/index.cfm?fuseaction=app.Faculties&organizationid=258&OfficeID=990&ElectionID=106): Board of Public Works Commissioners appointment & election history

## Council Files and Records

- [Council File 12-1681](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/lacityclerkconnect/index.cfm?fa=ccfi.viewrecord&cfnumber=12-1681): Council file 12-1681: Neighborhood Council district boundary policy
